name: hakim
description: Use ChatGPT as the conversational brain and Hakim as a privacy-minimized, permission-gated Android execution arm.

interface.longDescription: Hakim connects ChatGPT to an authorized Android device through a privacy-minimized execution bridge. The public version can check whether the paired device is connected, request opening a specific app or HTTP/HTTPS link, navigate Home/Back/Recents, and check request completion. Raw screenshots, notifications, arbitrary taps, free-form text entry, shell, and root are not exposed in the public plugin. State-changing actions remain subject to Hakim and Android approval gates.
defaultPrompt: Check whether my authorized Android device is connected through Hakim.
Open Chrome on my authorized Android device with Hakim.
Use Hakim to go back one screen on my authorized Android device.
